scripts.test: npm run test:docker && npm run test:other
scripts.test:docker: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/dispatch-cli.test.mjs tests/lifecycle-recovery.test.mjs tests/detached-dispatch.test.mjs tests/no-host-rights-vm.test.mjs tests/workspace-wipe-vm.test.mjs
scripts.test:other: files=""; for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do case "$f" in tests/dispatch-cli.test.mjs|tests/lifecycle-recovery.test.mjs|tests/detached-dispatch.test.mjs|tests/no-host-rights-vm.test.mjs|tests/workspace-wipe-vm.test.mjs) ;; *) files="$files $f";; esac; done; node --test $files
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run deadcode && npm run test && npm run roster:coherence
